section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1996
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1996 N.C.R.B.(M.H.A.) 2.3.5.2 A comparative statement on number of Registered Motor Vehicles, Population, accidents, casualties therein and rate of accidents per thousand vehicle and rate of vehicles per '000' population during 1995 for selected countries revealed that India has even low share of only 34 vehicle per thousand persons as compared to 650 and 603 vehicles in Switzerland and Austria respectively. In case of rate of accidents per thousands vehicles too, our country rated at 10.83 as compared to 28.16 and 22.6 in Hongkong and Pakistan respectively. However in other Western Countries the number of accidents per thousand vehicles was considerably low.
